profile.headline: Principal Software Developer, Naval Nuclear Laboratory. U.S. Army Officer, Signal Corps, Captain (Retired)
profile.summary:
Retired Military Officer with comprehensive leadership and problem solving skills.  Track record of
subject matter expertise across multiple technical disciplines such as encrypted Information
Technology (IT) networks, nuclear reactor operations, and Geographical Information Systems (GIS).
Mission focused, results driven, team oriented and personable.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer
positions.description: Software Asset Management.  Over 1000 software titles deployed to 10000+ authorized users around the globe on multiple enterprise networks, including offline classified networks.  Supports physical and virtual environments.  Software titles include standard office and business software as well as complex engineering software using a variety of license activation methods.  Performs vulnerability mitigation and management.  Provides Tier 3 support and focuses on process improvements.

positions.title: U.S. Army Officer, Signal Corps, Captain (Retired)
positions.description:
Signal Officer, Captain, Secret Security Clearance
Served as Commanding Officer during deployment in Iraq.   Personally responsible for the success or failure of all assigned missions, safety and welfare of 54 soldiers, and accountability of $13 million of equipment.  Accomplishments included providing robust, redundant, and reliable encrypted voice and data Information Technology (IT) networks for battlefield commanders and providing daily advisement and mission briefings to Senior Command Staff.
Served as IT Network Operation Officer for 28th Infantry Division. Routinely planned satellite system and IT Network training missions for drilling Guardsmen across the state. Served as IT Network Battle Captain in the Division Tactical Operation Center.  Supervised 24/7 operations of the tactical voice, data and IT server network, typically consisting of 200-300 users and several hundred network devices.  Coordinated adding Army Battlefield Command System (ABCS) client users to the tactical network. Supervised Help Desk operations.  Provided  proactive personal customer service to General Officers and other high profile users for their  IT network needs.  Responsible for detecting Cyber Security threats and for maintaining a posture of preventive measures across the network.  Supervised the Division’s Communication Security (COMSEC) account for classified encryption key distribution.  Coordinated vendor contractor support for specialized IT systems. Key member for the planning and operation of a highly successful Corps level digital Warfighter exercise in Fort Hood, TX,  during which over 1200 PA National Guard soldiers were trained as part of a 20,000 soldier multi-state digital war-gaming exercise.
Served as Assistant IT Network Officer at Mission Training Complex (MTC) Fort Indiantown Gap. Successfully assisted with the facility’s first DIACAP (Risk Management Framework) accreditation of its classified digital war-gaming simulation feed network.

positions.title: GIS Hydrographic Project Manager
positions.description: Developed a cost saving method of acquiring nautical charting data by crowd-sourcing data from recreational boaters to better serve coastal areas that would otherwise not receive funding for extensive surveying methods. The concept has since been adopted by the U.S. Government agency responsible for nautical charting and its success has been briefed to Congress.

positions.title: Lieutenant, Hydrographic Officer
positions.description:
NOAA Corps Uniformed Officer, Lieutenant, Officer of the Deck

Planned, supervised, and performed nautical charting projects in Alaska, Gulf of Mexico, and Atlantic
Coasts. Utilized GPS, GIS, side scan sonar, and multibeam sonar technologies.
Qualified Officer of the Deck and SCUBA Diver on three NOAA oceanographic research vessels.
Served as the government’s Contracting Officer Technical Representative (COTR) for over $3
million of Architecture and Engineering contracts to private sector ocean mapping firms.

positions.title: Senior Reactor Operator
positions.description:
NRC Licensed Senior Reactor Operator
Performed over 1000 start-ups and shutdowns of the university’s 1000 KW research nuclear reactor.  
Assisted research scientists with experimental setups for neutron activation analysis and radiography

positions.title: Submariner, Nuclear Reactor Operator ET1 (SS)
positions.description:
Electronics Technician 1st Class (SS), USS Birmingham SSN 695
Operated and maintained the submarine’s nuclear reactor and associated control systems. 
Qualified in Submarines
